title: Universal Life Insurance Disbursement Computation Sheet: Net Surrender Payment
content:
Computation of the net amount paid to the owner on the full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy.

## Definitions

1. **Effective date.** The received date of the owner's approved surrender request on the service record.
2. **Account value.** The account value shown at the latest monthly anniversary, as it stands on the policy record.
3. **Full-surrender charge booked.** The total of the surrender charge entries with the reason full surrender in the activity history.
4. **Premium refund booked on or after the latest monthly anniversary.** The amount of the most recent premium refund entry where that entry is dated on or after the latest monthly anniversary (the monthly anniversary of the most recent monthly deduction entry); nothing otherwise.
5. **Loan interest accrued to the effective date.** The loan balance on the policy record, times the loan charged rate for the policy year of the surrender, times the actual days from the loan interest paid-to date to the effective date, divided by 365. The loan charged rate is the tier's preferred loan charged rate, 3%, from the tier's preferred loan first policy year (policy year 11, or policy year 6 on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier); the surrender interim loan rate, **4.5%** (0.045), from the surrender interim loan year, policy year **6**, until then; and the tier's standard loan charged rate, 5%, before it.
6. **Cash surrender value.** The account value, less the full-surrender charge booked, less the premium refund booked on or after the latest monthly anniversary, less the loan balance and the loan interest accrued to the effective date.
7. **Surrender cost basis.** The gross premiums received (gross amounts of every premium received entry), less the premiums refunded (every premium refund entry), less the non-taxable part of earlier withdrawals, which is, over every partial withdrawal entry, its amount less its withdrawal fee less its taxable part.
8. **Taxable amount.** The account value, less the full-surrender charge booked and the premium refund booked on or after the latest monthly anniversary, less the surrender cost basis, never below zero.
9. **Federal tax withheld.** The tier's default federal withholding rate, 10% on every tier, of the taxable amount, unless the surrender request elects no withholding, in which case nothing.
10. **Net surrender payment.** The cash surrender value less the federal tax withheld, rounded to the cent once at the end; no intermediate figure is rounded.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Ashgrove Protection UL in policy year 8 at the effective date of 15 March 2025; loan interest paid to 1 January 2025 (73 days); withholding not declined.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Account value | $250000.00 |
| Full-surrender charge booked | $4000.00 |
| Premium refund on or after the latest monthly anniversary | none |
| Loan balance | $60000.00 |
| Loan interest: $60000.00 times 0.045 times 73 over 365 | $540.00 |
| Cash surrender value | $185460.00 |
| Surrender cost basis: gross premiums $180000.00, no refunds or withdrawals | $180000.00 |
| Taxable amount: $250000.00 less $4000.00 less $180000.00 | $66000.00 |
| Federal tax withheld at 10% | $6600.00 |
| Net surrender payment | $178860.00 |

Had the surrender request elected no withholding, the net surrender payment would be $185460.00.
